steps.title: Validate and select only uninjected adapters
body: Environment overrides .env. Only sqlite is a runtime store. Unknown names or missing selected Mongo credentials fail startup without printing values. Explicit injection takes precedence.

steps.title: Provider-neutral initialization and failures
body: Initialize and readiness belong to CardStorePort. SQLite translates expected failures to StorageUnavailable; HTTP preserves liveness, sanitized 503 and distinct 409.

steps.title: Only selected sink receives events
body: Mongo keeps its async queue and fallback. Stdout writes allowlisted JSON to API stdout; none drops events. Telemetry never determines readiness.

Storage lifelines represent separate Agent, Experience and Cards SQLite databases/volumes, not a shared database. Running jobs recover on restart. Uncertain supported writes reuse the original downstream key; non-idempotent writes are never replayed automatically.
